status: CONFIRMED by Greg 2026-10-06: R15 now makes all 30 days one continuous-learning experiment, without chronological or year-based discovery/confirmation knowledge gates. R17 keeps Granite a bounded active post-class coordinator/facilitator, never a scientific seat or calculator. R06 gives double-checked single occurrences the same validity, certainty and treatment as checked multiple occurrences, with no rarity handicap.
purpose: The one place the classroom rules live. The classroom code is to load this file and hold every answer, teacher reading and correction to it; Frankie's analysis cites it. Each rule names where it came from.

seats.frankie: the learner: his code, calculations and brain; his findings are claims
seats.boss_teacher: the original BOSS teacher: mathematics, representation supervision, targets, masks and controls, plus scientific research; code
seats.scientific_teacher: mechanism and evidence; tests every claim as a hypothesis with its own chance check (SPEC-scientific-teacher.md)

rules.rule: Observation, interpretation and hypothesis stay distinct. A state or value is an observation; its market meaning is interpretation; an unsupported developing structure is labelled HYPOTHESIS.
No future-outcome claim. Nothing in the classroom states or implies a later outcome; future_outcome_claimed is false in every answer and finding.

Complete coverage: all 19 dimensions in governed order, every retained cursor accounted for, all 171 pairs considered. Nothing is skipped because it is repetitive, neutral, missing, invalid or ablated.
rules.source: dipole_classroom.py:10 (complete Dipole coverage is invariant), :409; dipole_classroom_final_review.py:454

rules.rule: Zero data dropped: no caps, no truncation, nothing normalized or averaged. Unknown or incomplete data is listed, never dropped or filled in.

Never flatten or normalize dipole results. Coefficients are kept (each pair's Pearson over its own window, reported with its overlap count), and each pair also carries its co-movement counts; a coefficient is read per pair, per cell and per day, never pooled with others into one number, never averaged across results or normalized. Data may be grouped over a defined range and counted per group, never averaged.
rules.source: Greg 2026-09-29: "We want the coefficients, just not a bunch of dipole results flattened or normalized", "We can define a group them over a certain range but not an average"; CLAUDE.md D37 (no average as a verdict); the trading rules (per cell always, never pool)

rules.rule: A novel finding is never an error for being new. Double-check its mathematics, source evidence, causal timing and scientific work. When those checks hold, one occurrence is just as valid and certain as multiple occurrences and receives the same acceptance, survivor, curriculum and knowledge treatment. No minimum-occurrence requirement, rarity-based uncertainty label, confidence discount or automatic hypothesis-only status. Keep the result scoped to what the work actually checked. Occurrence counts describe the evidence without handicapping the finding; actual errors, contradictions or incomplete checks are judged on their merits.
rules.source: Greg 2026-10-06: one occurrence is just as valid and certain as multi occurrence as long as the math and science check out; double check the work and if it still works then they get the same treatment as anything else. Supersedes the older one-appearance promotion prohibition in dipole_classroom_final_review.py.

rules.rule: Corrections are specific: where a claim differs, the wording is 'the data is showing this instead', naming the values or states. Only the contradicted subclaim changes; a broader premise that is not itself contradicted stays.
Resolve every correction id in your own words (a bare id echo is not a resolution) and state any remaining disagreement explicitly.
The teachers see all the data except how Frankie makes decisions: his decision process is withheld.
Graded outcomes are kept out of the lesson material. The next cycle carries WHERE Frankie was corrected, never the answer key or the exhaustive grade.
Frankie's findings, his independent and novel ones included, reach both teachers as claims, never as truth, labelled as his.

The two teachers are tied together and keep their separate roles. The BOSS teacher hands over what it measured; the scientific teacher hands back its test results, challenges and proposed tests; each turn builds on the other's; a new discovery from the exchange is recorded as the teachers' own finding.
rules.source: DROP_IN_20260928_GRANITE_DECOUPLE.md, The two teachers are TIED TOGETHER; dipole_teacher_discussion.py (roles boss_teacher_scientific, scientific_teacher)

rules.rule: Nothing is dropped early. An early negative (one window, one day, one cell) is a scoped finding with its data named; a path is set aside only at the end of all research runs on the historical data. Dipole direction is open research.
A disposition word (supported, contradicted, unresolved, insufficient) is orientation only. The finding is what the test measured: its counts, cells and days, stated as what the data is showing.
rules.source: Greg's standing preference (outcomes open-ended, never a binary); dipole_scientific_review.py DISPOSITIONS

rules.rule: For this 30-day experiment, all assigned October 2021-2025 days participate in continuous learning. A completed stage's knowledge may be used at the next applicable workflow boundary regardless of trading date or the former discovery/confirmation label; October 2024 findings may teach a later-running October 2022 day. No year-based holdout or chronological knowledge-use barrier. Preserve raw per-day causal timestamps, host-answer walls and Jev's blind claim boundary. Keep findings individually source-bound and do not count reused evidence as an independent check.
rules.source: Greg 2026-10-06: 'It should. Again, chron should have no bearing on knowledge use in this experiment', confirming October 2024 knowledge may teach a later-running October 2022 day; supersedes the former year-based R15 split.

rules.rule: Duplicate data declines the run, with the reason.

No model computes or decides in the classroom. Every scientific seat's content comes from code, calculations or a measured test. After class, Granite may actively coordinate the three-seat discussion: ask bounded follow-up/clarifying questions, keep disagreements/open tests organized, and request that a code seat run or name the next test. Granite is not a fourth evidence seat and never calculates, grades, chooses survivors, confirms claims, forecasts or trades. A requested calculation is executed by the appropriate code stage before its result may be spoken. Every empirical statement remains bound to the speaking seat's source. Agreement among voices is never confirmation.
rules.source: Greg 2026-10-06: choose the active facilitator/coordinator plan for Granite; knowledge/GRANITE_DISCUSSION_COORDINATOR_ROLE_V2.md. Supersedes V2 R17 for the 30-day experiment.
